name: Git Cheat Sheet Interactive
summary: Searchable Git commands with one-click copy — setup, commit, branch, remote, and more.
description: Browse common Git commands by category or search. Click any command to copy it. Covers setup, staging, branches, remotes, history, undo, merge, and rebase. Runs entirely locally.

faqs.question: Does this run Git for me?
faqs.answer: No. It is a reference sheet. Copy commands into your own terminal.

faqs.question: Are destructive commands marked?
faqs.answer: Descriptions call out destructive actions such as restore, clean, and reset. Still double-check before running.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The cheat sheet is bundled and searched in your browser.
